t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I should be focusing on maximizing my ponits. The color pairs of the genomes are always the same. They'll lead me to different forests where I will be collecting mushrooms and the number I get will be constantly changing.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, Try maximizing your points by focusing on which genome leads you to the forest with the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms keep changing but what I have noticed is that mostly, the ones that gives the higher number of mushrooms, almost always gives a higher number. It does change to a lower number some time but mostly it is high, so pay attention and be consistent.
